verdict.rationale: Exa Websets provides event-driven automation of its own: real-time HTTP webhook callbacks fire when items are added or enriched, and scheduled searches surface new web events. However, the evidence shows no general rule engine where users define conditions mapped to arbitrary actions; the only action documented is a callback or notification. Missing for 10: user-definable condition→action rules, a choice of action types beyond webhook delivery, detailed docs on configuring triggers or filtering events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Get real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched
Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web.
Results arrive asynchronously through the dashboard, API, or webhooks.
